September 4, 1916

Jumping on and off Trains

Thet it shall be unlawful for any person to jump off or on a train in the Town limits while ssid train is in motion, unless the person so doing is unavoidably laste or detained in such manner as will justify them in the act.

That no person shali be allowed to willfuliy or neglectfully delay getting on or off trains, even when they have business on or off such trains.

And any one getting on a train with the intention of jumping off, or running or rushing by or through other persons endangering their lives and safety, shall he deemed guilty of Disorderly Conduct and upon conviction shall he fined not exceeding twenty five dollars or work on the streets not more than thirty days for any offenses mentioned above.
